name: stratek-connectors
description: Stratek connector: runs in your own Cloudflare account, holds your integration keys (Pathao, payments...) and adds their buttons to the Stratek POS.

scripts.test: node --test test/connector.test.js test/bundle.test.js test/integrations.test.js test/integrations2.test.js test/modes.test.js

STATE.description: Where the connector remembers which Stratek account it is connected to. Created for you -- nothing to change.

STRATEK_URL.description: Your Stratek POS address. Leave as **https://strateknepal.com** unless you run your own Stratek.
